طِرِمَّاحٌ , of the very rare measure فِعِلَّالٌ, of which there can hardly, or cannot at all, be found any other example, except سِنِمَّارٌ, a foreign word, and سِجِلَّاطٌ, also said to be of foreign origin, (TA,) A man of high ancestry or family, and celebrated; (K, TA;) of high renown. (TA.) ―
-b2- And One who goes, or penetrates, far, or deeply, into an affair. (AZ, K, TA.) ―
-b3- And accord. to Abu-l-'Omeythil El-Aarábee, One who elevates his head in pride. (TA.) ―
-b4- See also طُرْمُوحٌ.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
